name: Question 13
problem:
Suppose we wish to approximate the solution to an initial value problem using Euler's method:

$$
\begin{aligned}Δy & ={y}^{′}\cdot Δx \\ {y}_{\text{new}} & =y+Δy\end{aligned}
$$

If the exact solution is ${y}_{\text{exact}}(x)=\frac{1}{x},$ find an expression for the local truncation error for the step from $x$ to ${x}_{\text{new}}=x+Δx.$

Question 13
?

Suppose we wish to approximate the solution to an initial value problem using Euler's method: Δy=y′⋅Δxynew=y+Δy If the exact solution is yexact(x)=1x, find an expression for the local truncation error for the step from x to xnew=x+Δx.

a
1x2⋅Δx
b
1x+Δx
c
1x+Δx−1x
d
0
e
1x+Δx−(1x−1x2⋅Δx)
